response.justification: Bogdan has deep technical expertise, extensive open-source contributions, and leadership in diverse tech environments, but lacks demonstrated experience in IT architecture design, UML, formal project management, and crucially, German proficiency is only basic despite C1 being required.
strengths: Strong open-source leadership with GISCollective and multiple public libraries
Proven full-stack experience across languages, platforms, and high-scale systems
Active mentorship and workshop facilitation showing communication and teaching ability
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, falling far short of required C1 level
No explicit evidence of UML, IT architecture design, or formal project management experience
Lacks documented experience in security, compliance, or risk management contexts
